modification.solution:
def solve(text):
    left = 0
    right = len(text) - 1
    while left < right and text[left] == text[right]:
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    i = left + 1
    j = right
    while i < j and text[i] == text[j]:
        i += 1
        j -= 1
    if i >= j:
        return True
    i = left
    j = right - 1
    while i < j and text[i] == text[j]:
        i += 1
        j -= 1
    return i >= j
